entities.summary: Yug Purushottama Sri Sri Thakur Anukulchandra, popularly known as Sree Sree Thakur, was an Indian homeopathic physician and spiritual guru and the founder of Satsang, in Deoghar, Jharkhand. He was born in a Brahmin family.
